Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Represents PostgreSQL time with time zone as a local time and a fixed offset, without a date or zone name.

```csharp
public readonly struct PgTimeTz : IComparable<PgTimeTz>, IEquatable<PgTimeTz>
```

Implements: [IComparable&lt;PgTimeTz&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.icomparable-1), [IEquatable&lt;PgTimeTz&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iequatable-1)

## Constructors

<a id="member-3a522ee3e8badc08"></a>

### PgTimeTz(PgTime, int)

Creates a time with a signed offset east of UTC, retaining second-resolution historical offsets.

```csharp
public PgTimeTz(PgTime time, int offsetSeconds)
```

Parameters:

`time` — [PgTime](/api/ankus.pgtime/)

The local time, including 24:00:00.

`offsetSeconds` — [int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)

The offset east of UTC, strictly between -57,600 and 57,600 seconds.

Exceptions:

- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): The offset is outside PostgreSQL's supported range.
